QF.id: Issue Management - General Obligations and Due Diligence_70

question.text: Within how many working days after the stabilization period must the shares lent under the Green Shoe Option be returned to the pre-issue shareholder?

explanation.text: The Logic: Specified securities bought and credited under the Green Shoe Option must be returned immediately and, in any case, not later than two working days after the end of the stabilisation period. The Trap: 5 working days and 3 working days are common SEBI-timeline distractors. 1 working day is impractically short and is not the prescribed limit. Note: The rule emphasises immediate return after stabilisation, with two working days serving as the outer limit.
